svg.aria-label: Who picks up? Dadi, a different grandmother every call; Pinky Didi, a college student who checks; Dadaji, a retired government clerk. Each takes a turn ringing, with her own Gnani voice and traits.
svg.text: You never know. Work her out from how she talks.
